sources.name: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

verified_rules.national_rent_control_from_1_march_2026: For private tenancies and Student Specific Accommodation, RTB guidance states that rent may generally be increased once every 12 months by 2% or CPI, whichever is lower, subject to stated exceptions.
verified_rules.new_private_tenancy_market_reset: For private tenancies created from 1 March 2026, RTB guidance identifies specified circumstances in which market-rent resetting is permitted, including at the beginning of a new tenancy in specified circumstances and at the end of a six-year tenancy cycle.
verified_rules.special_new_apartment_rule: RTB guidance identifies a special rule for a new private apartment where construction commenced after 10 June 2025: annual review is linked to CPI and the 2% cap does not apply, subject to the applicable conditions.
